title: Concert A became 440 Hz only in the twentieth century
body: Pitch was local for centuries: surviving organs and forks suggest Baroque pitch often sat near or below 415 Hz, a semitone under modern. International agreement crept in via a 1939 conference and an ISO standard in 1955 fixing A at 440 Hz. Orchestras have since drifted sharp again for brilliance, standards notwithstanding.
